Compose Interface System
Inferred Product Architecture

Deterministic inferences derived from brief vocabulary and archetype priors.

Validated product model
DETERMINISTIC ASSUMPTIONS
Identified primary archetype as "Employee Experience" based on domain vocabulary.
Inferred target audience as "Employees, team leads and people operations teams".
Inferred primary objective: "Help employees connect with their teams, complete onboarding, share feedback and access organisational policies".
Applied feel descriptors "professional but playful" with mathematical DNA adjustments.
Applied Visual Ambition level 30 to motion, typography, and depth.
Applied Structural Creativity level 55 to spatial topology.
Primary Archetype
EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE
User Sophistication
55/100
Trust Requirement
85/100
Data Density
55/100
Information Complexity
55/100
Mobile Priority
50/100
Planned ScreenGraph (9 Screens)

Structured screen classes, route slugs, required section roles, and navigation hierarchy.

8 Required
1 Optional
MARKETING GROUP
Marketing Home
/
Required

Product value proposition, interactive preview, and conversion funnel.

Required Roles: navigation, hero, value-proposition...
APPLICATION GROUP
Team Overview
/overview
Required

Employee summary, onboarding progress and team pulse

Required Roles: overview-header, metric-cards, activity-feed...
People Directory
/people
Required

Searchable, filterable catalog of all employee records.

Required Roles: index-header, filter-bar, data-table...
Employee Profile
/people/:id
Optional

Deep inspection, metadata attributes, timeline, and actions for a single employee.

Required Roles: entity-header, detail-tabs, main-content-pane...
Teams
/teams
Required

Explore team membership and shared priorities

Required Roles: index-header, filter-bar, data-table...
Onboarding
/onboarding
Required

Playful welcome journey with clear milestones

Required Roles: progress-stepper, wizard-content, action-controls...
Engagement
/engagement
Required

Review employee feedback and recognition

Required Roles: overview-header, metric-cards, activity-feed...
SETTINGS & ADMINISTRATION GROUP
Settings & Policies
/settings
Required

Organisational policies, notifications and account preferences

Required Roles: settings-nav, settings-form, save-footer...
AUTHENTICATION GROUP
Sign In
/sign-in
Required

User authentication with GitHub OAuth and session tokens.

Required Roles: auth-card, auth-footer...
Three Generated Directions

Deterministic directions generated from intent: conservative fit, expressive fit, and structural alternative.

DIRECTION 01
Conservative Fit
Calm Foundation

Closest to inferred product priors with standard sidebar navigation, reinforced accessibility floors, and rock-solid predictable ergonomics.
